name: Nearest Neighbor Feature Matching Loss
definition: A style loss that minimizes the distance between local feature vectors of a rendered image and the nearest neighbor feature vectors in a style image's feature map, used to capture distinctive local details like brushstrokes better than global statistics.
summary: Nearest Neighbor Feature Matching Loss is a style loss that minimizes distances between rendered features and their closest style counterparts, enabling high-frequency detail transfer while maintaining multi-view consistency in 3D radiance fields.
